classPlans.hypothesis: Striker takes Forest speed early and swaps to the Cave axe; Mountain armor loses to Plains plating, and Desert/Jungle offer it nothing by the time it arrives.

skip.knight-steelsword: 18 attack at 1.0 aps is below the Tier-1 weapon this class ends on; its technique-cooldown mechanic does not pay for the DPS loss

skip.forest-vest-t2: 24% evasion is strong, but Cadence already caps its worst hit; plating is worth more
skip.thorn-needle: on-hit damage does not interact with the Cadence finisher

skip.swamp-mirebrand: a DoT weapon on a burst class -- the reservoir competes with the finisher
skip.swamp-vest-t2: DoT resistance is a Swamp-local answer; the route leaves Swamp

skip.quake-hammer: 0.55 aps starves a hit-counter mechanic of counter ticks

skip.cave-boots-t2: stealth does not serve a class that wants to be hit into its recovery pulse

skip.jungle-stinger-rapier: on-hit damage suits Light on-hit builds, not a finisher class
skip.jungle-vest-t2: strictly below cave-vest-t2 in both plating and damage reduction

skip.desert-sunsteel-cross: a fight-opening weapon on a sustained-rhythm class (rationale predates the 2026-09-15 alpha-window rework - revisit)
skip.desert-vest-t2: arrives last and is not an upgrade on cave-vest-t2

skip.knight-steelsword: 18 attack at 1.0 aps is below the Tier-1 weapon this class ends on; its technique-cooldown mechanic does not pay for the DPS loss

skip.gale-needle: a 9-attack fast weapon is the worst possible fit for a per-cast burst class
skip.forest-vest-t2: evasion is a poor fit for the heaviest plating chassis in the game

skip.swamp-mirebrand: the DoT reservoir does not scale with the execution hit

skip.cave-vest-t2: 13% damage reduction is real, but mountain-vest is the tier's only Guard scaler

skip.jungle-stinger-rapier: fast on-hit is the opposite of this class's mechanic

skip.desert-vest-t2: cheat-death is attractive, but arrives after the run is already decided

classPlans.hypothesis: Apprentice wants the Swamp DoT weapon its whole mechanic is built on, Swamp armor for the attrition matchups, and Bramble Guard to compensate for the weakest AoE in the game. Jungle and Desert are predicted to offer it almost nothing.

skip.knight-steelsword: 18 attack at 1.0 aps is below the Tier-1 weapon this class ends on; its technique-cooldown mechanic does not pay for the DPS loss

skip.gale-needle: raw speed without conversion does not feed a reservoir build
skip.thorn-needle: on-hit damage is flat and does not convert into DoT

skip.mountain-vest-t2: guard potency does nothing for a class whose Guard is Second Wind

skip.cave-vest-t2: swamp-vest-t2's DoT resistance is the defence this build actually lacks

skip.jungle-stinger-rapier: no DoT conversion; the on-hit component is wasted here

skip.desert-sunsteel-cross: an opening-burst weapon on the slowest-killing class in the tier (rationale predates the 2026-09-15 alpha-window rework - revisit)
skip.desert-vest-t2: arrives too late to change the Jungle/Desert wall

classPlans.hypothesis: OPEN QUESTION, held deliberately neutral. Conduit's damage runs through minions that inherit player stats, so whether it prefers a slow high-attack weapon or a fast one depends on whether inheritance is per-hit or throughput-based -- see the Conduit scaling note. This plan takes the high-attack Cave axe and records the result rather than guessing; the fast-weapon arm is the paired probe.

skip.forest-vest-t2: the player is not the intended damage target; plating serves better

skip.swamp-mirebrand: minion inheritance of a reservoir DoT is unverified

skip.mountain-vest-t2: guard potency does not serve Second Wind

skip.jungle-stinger-rapier: held for the paired fast-weapon probe instead

skip.desert-sunsteel-cross: a formation class has no single opening strike to double (rationale predates the 2026-09-15 alpha-window rework - revisit)
